author: Arachadonic
body:
Okay so this is going to be a bit of a rant/suggestion so please bear with me and read it all before posting. Its just some feedback and if you don't want it then don't make a feedback section. Just want to say first though that this isn't an attack on any staff member or player. It is just my opinion and what I have noticed while being here actively for a month.

"Where is the consistency?" 
I am asking this because of things like this:



Here, as you can see, two Mods commented on this chap's thread where he was celebrating the fact he had reached x amount of kills or something. However then a third Mod locks the thread for the rule you can see in the screenshot. In my mind, this just makes the staff team look a bit un-organised or/and just not on the same page which is not good and to me shows maybe a lack of communication within the staff group (which may not be the case! It just came across this way to me)

Now keep in mind that I am not blaming the staff members or anything, I mean it is pretty understandable considering how open to interpretation the rules are in relation to this subject matter, which is fair enough as each situation is different.

Another sort of incident like this is that I have seen multiple well known regulars (one in particular)
who is not shy to throw these rules on a thread if they think it breaks them, and not a word is said to them. Yet when I sympathised with a poster and posted the same rules on a thread that in my opinion was personal and "did not belong on a minecraft community forum", I was straight away set upon by players who said I should stop being a dick and should not be enforcing the rules when I am not a staff member.. I fail to see how 1) Not having a title makes me any less entitled to enforce rules or try help out 2) Being "popular" or "well-known" allows you to post stuff without fear of people jumping at you... 

Here are the rules in question:



Before coming to this server and community, I had never ever in my 3 years of Minecraft seen rules such as these in a community. I mean the suggested banning of prestige threads, which are a big moment for players who want to share it with people, is just so so silly. Look at any big minecraft community, Hypixel or Mineplex and on their forums they embrace the social media aspect of being a community, with tags, status updates, friends, private messaging etc. which is probably why their forums are as busy as they are. Now I'm not saying we have to add all this stuff but I mean it works, and stuff like Private Messaging are so basic I question why they are not already here!

My suggestion is this: Remove them two rules from this community. 
We are supposed to be a community yes? Then why not start acting like one! When I think of community, I just think of personal stuff. Getting personal with people is what brings people closer together and could let people get to know each other better, giving a greater sense of community.
Also the fact that these rules seem to confuse literally every single person here is just another reason why they should be removed. I see constant threads how "XYZ should be banned cause its personal" and just lots of confusion on threads of what is personal and what isn't. Lets embrace personal updates and statuses! 

Anyway that's my super long nonsense over. Thanks if you stuck it through and read it throughout the end. I won't be repeating anything that was said in the post so I do think you should try read it all.
